title: The Rechabites
lead: A clan of Kenite descent that kept the rules of its ancestor Jonadab son of Rechab (no wine, no houses, fields or vineyards, but tents). Jonadab backed Jehu's war on Baal worship about 841 BC (2 Kings 10:15-23), and Jeremiah used the clan's obedience to shame Judah's disobedience (Jeremiah 35).
